author: TheWhisperingEye
text_post: Should i ask her out one last time? Hi guys,  Cutting the story sort of short.... I've been on 2 very successful dates with this girl i met. she initiates pretty much all the kissing, holding hands stuff etc whilst on dates and she seems really interested when we're out together.  However on the 2nd date she mentioned i don't contact her enough inbetween dates and i told her the only reason i don't is cos "i don't wanna become that annoying person who wont leave you alone".I also said its not like she cant contact me etc but she pretty much wants me to initiate all the contact and being the guy i can kinda understand that as girls like to be chased and all that.  I said on date 2 about a 3rd date and she was excited for it, so i asked her properly about 5 days later and she couldn't cos she was working all weekend so i asked about the following week and she said "yeah, i'll let ya know cos i gotta finish my last 2 essays for her final degree work due in 2weeks time" which is fast forward to this coming week.  I've kept the contact with her through text every 3/4 days since then an she tends to randomly stop reply mid convo even when they ain't boring and i text her today asking about her weekend but got no reply.  I have no reason to think she wouldn't be interested since when we're actually together its really good and the fact she said she's up for a 3rd date.feel like ive gone wrong somewhere. Just wanna know if it sounds like shes lost interest or if i should ask her out one last time? Any advice would be helpful, Cheers!

author: Master Phoenix
text_post: You should aske her out again, if you want, but keep in mind a couple of things: She did say she was busy, so, that could be a factor on why she is not replying as much. Also, and I cannot stress enough the importance of this: In text game you should only ask questions that drive the conversation forward, and preferably, that guarantee a short but sure reply. if you ask "How are you?", "How was your weekend?", "What are you doing?" she will not be likely to respond, since the reply is either obvious, lengthy, or she feels you are just trying too hard to come up with something to say that you fall back on random chat "polite" topics. (You know,the whole "How R U?" "I'm fine, you?" "I'm fine too" thing...) In your particular case, just use DHV's to remind her why you are such a great guy to hang out with, and try to keep the date as casual as you can (outing with more friends if possible) so as to not make her the center of attention. This way, the focus will be on hanging out, you can build more attraction, and also you show that your social lie is not stagnant without her, and any discomfort she may feel regarding a "date" scenario will be diminished by the fact that you are on a "neutral" scene where your mind is not 100% focused on her, but rather, on having a good time along with her.  Makes sense? So, yeah, ask her out again, but do it in a non-threatening way and do not show too much interest or eagerness to see her again (though, don't be dismissive either), better yet, remind her why she wants to see you. Hope this helps. All the best.

author: Magic_Man
text_post: 3 - 4 days is a bit much time to text in between seeing her, you can do 3 days but I usually like to text every other day (basically 2 days, 3 days depending on if I've got a lot going on). Unless of course the conversation is just flowing, then sometimes conversation can take place over a couple of days.  Don't read into her not replying to texts too much, they're really low investment. Its important to remember that you don't always have an idea of what is going on in her life, she could be busy or away from her phone (as she mentioned anyway). I always forget to answers texts; its normal. Another thing to remember about texts is staying persistent, you can always ping her with low investment texts about your day if you're not sure what to start a conversation with, just make sure the text has something she can reply to. That being said, try asking her out again once this school stuff passes, if she's still making excuses, then you may need to question whether or not you should continue. MM
